import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Plot a boxplot of Sleep Duration by BMI Category
sns.boxplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=data, palette='pastel')

# Add a title and labels
plt.title('Sleep Duration by BMI Category', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=14)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
